project_name: Name of the commercial real estate project or permit.
city: City where the project is located (e.g., ATL for Atlanta, DC for Washington).
ward: Local administrative district or ward number.
developer: The entity responsible for developing the project.
architect: The architectural firm involved in the project design.
sector: The asset class (e.g., Multifamily, Office, Industrial, Retail, Hotel, Mixed-Use).
status: Current phase of the project (e.g., Planned, Under Construction, Delivered).
est_value_millions: Estimated dollar amount of construction/investment in millions of USD.
report_year: The year the data was recorded or is being analyzed for.
growth_pressure: A Z-score normalized value representing development intensity relative to the mean.
growth_status: Categorized growth based on Z-score: Decline (Z < -1), Stagnation (-1 <= Z <= 1), Increase (Z > 1).
